name: ai-assisted-citizen-request-app
description: An AI-assisted web platform for reporting, routing, and tracking municipal issues.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:web && npm run install:api
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:api:fix && npm run lint:web:fix
